items.title: ttok 0.4
items.summary:
Release: ttok 0.4
        ttok is my CLI tool for counting tokens, using OpenAI's open source tiktoken library.
It hasn't been in updated in a couple of years, but I finally fixed a Click warning, updated CI, and added a --list-models command to list available models.
It works with uvx, so you can count tokens in anything like this:
cat file.txt | uvx ttok

items.title: Quoting Carson Gross
items.summary:
Computer programming is, fundamentally, about two things:

Problem-solving using computers
Learning to control complexity while solving these problems

I have a hard time imagining a future where knowing how to solve problems with computers and how to control the complexity of those solutions is less valuable than it is today, so I think it will continue to be a viable career even with the advent of AI tools.
— Carson Gross

    Tags: computer-science, carson-gross, careers, ai
